paper.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
paper.central_claim: 通过共享骨干的 Challenger/Planner/Solver/Critic 联合强化学习，从500种子自动扩充课程，提升数学及代码推理。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: pinned text read before opening seat records (abstract, method, experiments, all tables, appendices; long proof derivations skimmed) ; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: SAGE is distinguished by integrating planning and critic roles to decompose reasoning and jointly train all agents for improved stability and depth in math and code domains.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻差异为训练角色组合；未独立核对邻居原文。

evidence.quote: forming a self-rewarding cycle trained end-to-end using task-relative policy gradients.
evidence.support_explanation: The self-evolution loop is closed by policy-gradient training.

evidence.quote: jointly updates the shared backbone using Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization
evidence.support_explanation: All four roles share one backbone; the update step modifies model weights.

evidence.quote: All agents are initialized from their corresponding base models.
evidence.support_explanation: Roles are weight copies of one LLM (LoRA rank 128 per Sec.5.1); no prompt/skill/tool/memory artifact is the retained object.

evidence.quote: (4) all agents are jointly updated using Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization.
evidence.support_explanation: Confirms the retained output of each iteration is updated weights; the question pool D is training data for those weights.

evidence.quote: all agents are jointly updated using Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization.
evidence.support_explanation: All four roles improve by a shared weight update.

The growing question pool is training data for the RL update, not a harness component read at test time.

signatures.object: 共享LLM骨干LoRA权重及训练数据池
signatures.information: 500 seed questions+answers/tests；生成的题目、验证器、solver成功率、critic分数
signatures.operation: Challenger生成题和验证器；质量过滤并加入数据池；planner提供计划；solver求解；按角色奖励联合更新参数
signatures.conditions: 数学/代码可验证域；质量阈值0.7、计划阈值0.3
signatures.selection_rule: 可解析可执行验证器且quality≥0.7进入训练数据；不是非权重部署组件晋升
signatures.persistence: 训练数据池累积，推理能力写入LoRA参数
signatures.later_use: 评测微调后模型，而非重新读取可编辑非权重能力库
signatures.failure_boundary: 训练过久退化；自生成verifier有效性不等于语义真值

rs_pattern.reason: Informational (out_of_scope). Opus confirms sol: the generator proposes verifiable tasks, the solver's pass rate steers the generator, a filter (critic score / validity checks) admits tasks, and the shared policy is retrained. This is C08's generate → steer → filter → retrain loop, the run convention for proposer–solver co-training (r05b R-Zero, r07b Search Self-play/SPICE, r09b GenEnv, r11a Dr. Zero). son55 skipped identification. The run records identification for excluded rows, so the empty pattern is replaced. No score effect.
